title: Full inner product prefix
statement: For every natural number $m$ and Boolean vector $w$ of length $2m$, the sum in $\mathbb{F}_2$ of the products of the two bits in each of the $m$ corresponding coordinate pairs equals the inner product modulo two of the two length-$m$ blocks obtained by splitting $w$ into halves.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a Boolean vector of length $2m$
